title: Engine Electronic Control Unit — Installation
abstract: Installation of the engine electronic control unit, with the isolator preload setting, the harness clearance check through full deflection and the ground power system test that closes the task without an engine run.

sections.purpose: This task installs the engine electronic control unit on the fan case, sets the isolator preload where the soft mounting is fitted, and proves the installation on ground power.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the engine shut down and the start and ignition circuits still tagged. The isolator preload is set with the gauge to the dimension in the accomplishment instructions; an isolator set by feel will either bottom out under load or allow the unit to contact the shroud. The harness clearance must be checked through the full isolator deflection, not at rest. No engine run is required to close the task.
sections.procedure: 1. Check the mounting face and the fastener holes for damage. 2. Where the isolator mounting is fitted, install the isolator bracket and set the preload with the tubular spacers EN25879-6A to the dimension given, using the preload gauge. CAUTION: AN ISOLATOR SET BY FEEL WILL EITHER BOTTOM OUT UNDER LOAD OR LET THE UNIT TOUCH THE SHROUD. 3. Lift the unit into position with the handling bracket and install the mounting hardware. 4. Torque the mounting hardware in the sequence in the torque table. 5. Install the ventilated shroud and close its seam with solid rivets AGS860444K6. 6. Fit protective sleeving AES911172K8 where the control harness crosses the isolator travel. 7. Push the unit through its full isolator deflection by hand and check the harness clearance at each extreme. WARNING: DO NOT RELEASE THE AIRCRAFT WITH LESS THAN THE MINIMUM HARNESS CLEARANCE. THE HARNESS WILL CHAFE IN SERVICE. 8. Connect the power connector first, then the harness connectors, then the signal connectors. 9. Torque the pylon connector at position 189EF to the value given. 10. Confirm that the control unit database LC7C004B308 is at the standard recorded for the aircraft; no data load is required for this task. 11. Do the engine electronic control system test on ground power and check that no fault is raised. 12. Close the fan cowl doors and check the latch alignment.
sections.close_out: Remove the hold-open rods and the tags. Record the installation, the unit serial number, the isolator preload dimension, the harness clearance and the system test result in the aircraft technical log. Report any isolator that could not be set within the dimension band.

type_data.effectivity_note: Auran-powered SLN-30R3 and SLN-34R3 aircraft; steps 2, 6 and 7 apply post MOD-137030 only

safety_precautions: Keep the start and ignition circuits tagged until step 11.
Do not release the aircraft with less than the minimum harness clearance.
Support the unit until the mounting hardware is torqued.
